4592: Small private RV park in Sylvania, about 30 minutes from Statesboro and an hour from Augusta and Savannah, also listed as Savannah River RV Park; it takes nightly, weekly and long-term stays. --Claude
4595: Private RV park and outdoor center on Big Cedar Creek at Cave Spring, with 62 full-hookup RV sites plus tent and group sites, and canoe, kayak and tube rentals with a shuttle; the creekside sites have more tree cover. --Claude
4605: Private RV park in Bainbridge beside the Bainbridge Boat Basin park on the Flint River, with a pool and propane. --Claude
4618: Yogi Bear's Jellystone Park family camp-resort at Cochran, run by Kaliber Management, with tent sites, cabins, a pool and a dog park; it also rents by the week and month. --Claude
4647: Private campground on Lookout Mountain at Rising Fawn, near Cloudland Canyon State Park, with overnight RV sites around a fountain pond, creekside sites, a separate area for extended stays, cabins and a playground. --Claude
4657: Private park just off I-75 exit 127 at Elko, with 35 pull-throughs and shady back-ins, cabins, a pool and a clubhouse; long-term residents share it with nightly guests. --Claude
4661: RV resort with a 9-hole golf course west of Ashburn, run by Outdoor Adventure Retreats, with a pool, a clubhouse and cafe, and a 7-acre fishing lake; it takes long stays as well as nightly ones. --Claude
4662: Family-owned rural RV park near Sandersville, open since 2012, with tent areas, a pond and ATV and walking trails; it takes short and long stays. --Claude
4673: Private RV park in Lowndes County at Hahira, sold by its original owners in February 2023; some sites are rented by the month, but it takes nightly guests. --Claude
4678: City of Euharlee campground in Frankie Harris Park, near Euharlee Creek and its historic covered bridge, with paved back-in sites and a bathhouse. --Claude
4748: Small RV park in Bristol across from the Apalachicola River, with level rock pads, taking short and extended stays. --Claude
4778: Private RV park on US-19/98 at Inglis, about 12 minutes north of Crystal River and 10 from the Gulf, between the Withlacoochee River and the Cross Florida Barge Canal, with oversized lots, two bathhouses and a heated pool. --Claude
4781: Gated RV resort at Crescent City where owners hold many of the lots, with 80-plus big-rig sites, free cable, a heated pool, pickleball, a dog park, a clubhouse and propane; children and pets are welcome, but the lodge cabins are adults-only. --Claude
4785: Resort on the St. Johns River at Welaka with RV-only sites, a pool, a restaurant and bar, a boat ramp, a fishing dock, and boat and kayak rentals; it takes nightly, weekly and monthly stays. --Claude
4788: All-ages RV park off I-75 exit 309, formerly the Escapees club's Sumter Oaks and now independent, mixing nightly, weekly and monthly stays. --Claude
4831: Dixie County park at Gornto Springs on the Suwannee River, a clear spring that stays near 72°F all year, with steps into the spring, a small beach, picnic shelters and a boat ramp. --Claude
5062: Town of Sturgis RV park in Diane Jackson Memorial Park, about 15 minutes from Starkville, with a shaded pavilion, a playground and ball fields; it is popular on Mississippi State game days. --Claude
5079: Webster County recreation area on 300-acre Whites Creek Lake near Eupora, with swimming, fishing and boating.  Eight RV sites are rented by the night and three by the month, on gravel pads, and one has a lake view. --Claude
5081: RV campground just off I-20 at Edwards, about 20 minutes from Vicksburg, with lakeside and shaded woodland sites on level gravel or grass, a 15-acre stocked fishing lake and a pool; under new owners since June 2023. --Claude
5118: Private RV park off US-49 north of Hattiesburg, with free satellite TV and a stocked fishing pond; standard sites run 40 to 50 feet, and a few pull-throughs are held for travelers. --Claude
5122: Private RV park off I-55 exit 119, minutes from historic downtown Canton, the film location for 'A Time to Kill' and 'O Brother, Where Art Thou?', with green space and rental cabins. --Claude
5279: Private campground on US-62 at Eureka Springs, with a pool, a pavilion and a playground; about 48 of the sites have full hookups. --Claude
